verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a cloud communications SaaS like RingCentral, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents data residency or region selection. The only mention of 'global regions' refers to replacing PBX systems across office locations, not to where customer data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
